summary: Bound oversized POST list pages that carry a continuation cursor or more flag as a page of entries instead of a 4,000-byte string preview, and rename the upstream cursor to cursor_after_page with retry_page_size when entries are cut.
reason: Every Dropbox list endpoint is an RPC POST with an empty MCP page config, so endpointResponse only had a list path for GET. Pages above 60,000 bytes became non-resumable previews, and keeping the upstream cursor on a cut page would skip the omitted entries.
validated_outcome: TestEndpointResponseBoundsPOSTCursorListAsEntries and TestEndpointResponseBoundsPOSTContinuationWithMoreFlag fail on the generated bound.go and pass with the patch. If a reprint emits POST-aware list bounding in the generator, drop this patch.
